source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/Levels.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_levels.py and checked by Lean's kernel

tolerance.reason: no rounding: a level is a whole number, and the library's rounded share of the range has the whole part that the exact share has for every value; the expected value is exact
